description: This file defines a mock class for the IGenericPlayerTaskFactory interface used in testing. It provides mock methods for creating various player tasks related to media playback, such as attaching samples, handling bus messages, and controlling playback states. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and is used for unit testing within the media playback component.
